stepExplanation:
Using v² = u² + 2as, where v = 0, u = 20 m/s, a = -4 m/s² (negative because decelerating):
$$0 = (20)^2 + 2(-4)s$$
$$0 = 400 - 8s$$
$$8s = 400$$
$$s = 50 \text{ m}$$
stepBody: Using v² = u² + 2as, calculate the displacement. Given: u = 20 m/s, v = 0 m/s (comes to rest), a = -4 m/s². Give your answer in metres.
